concepts.title: Area of a Trapezium
concepts.definition: The measure of the two-dimensional region enclosed by a quadrilateral that has exactly one pair of parallel sides.
concepts.key_idea: Take the mean of the two matching sides, then multiply by the perpendicular gap.

solution_steps.explain: Add the lengths of the two parallel sides, side_a and side_b.

solution_steps.action: Multiply by height and divide by 2
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the sum of the parallel sides by the height and then divide by 2 to obtain the area.

concepts.title: Area of a Rhombus from Diagonals
concepts.definition: The total space enclosed by a rhombus, determined by taking half the product of its two perpendicular diagonals.
concepts.key_idea: Half of slanted-measure-1 times slanted-measure-2 gives the covered region.

solution_steps.explain: Calculate the product of the lengths of the two diagonals, d1 and d2.
Multiply the diagonal product by 0.5 to find the total area.

concepts.title: Area of a General Quadrilateral
concepts.definition: The area of any four-sided polygon calculated by splitting it along a diagonal into two triangles and summing their areas using perpendicular offsets.
concepts.key_idea: Two triangles lean on the same slanted measure; total their halves.
question_patterns: find the area of a quadrilateral shaped field with diagonal

solution_steps.explain: Add the perpendicular offsets h1 and h2 drawn from opposite vertices to the diagonal.

solution_steps.action: Multiply by diagonal and divide by 2
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the sum of heights by the diagonal length and divide by 2.

concepts.title: Total Surface Area of a Cuboid
concepts.definition: The combined area of all six rectangular faces of a box-shaped solid.
concepts.formula: area = 2 * (length * width + width * height + height * length)
concepts.key_idea: Twice the sum of the products of the three pairs of adjacent dimensions.

solution_steps.action: Calculate the sum of the products of adjacent sides
solution_steps.explain: Multiply length by width, width by height, and height by length, then add these three products.
solution_steps.compute: sum_products = length * width + width * height + height * length

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the sum of the products of adjacent sides by 2 to get the total surface area.

concepts.title: Lateral Surface Area of a Cuboid
concepts.definition: The combined area of the four upright faces of a box-shaped solid, skips the lid and floor.
concepts.key_idea: Walk the floor's border, then multiply by how tall the walls stand.
question_patterns: find the lateral surface area of a cuboid

solution_steps.action: Find the sum of length and width
solution_steps.explain: Add the length and width of the base of the cuboid.
Multiply the sum of length and width by 2 and then by the height to find the lateral surface area.

concepts.title: Total Surface Area of a Cube
concepts.definition: The total outer area of a regular six-faced three-dimensional solid where all edges are equal in length.
concepts.key_idea: Six times the square of the side length.
question_patterns: find the surface area of a cube

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the side length by itself to find the area of one face.
Multiply the area of a single face by 6 to get the total surface area of the cube.

concepts.title: Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder
concepts.definition: The rolled-sheet area of a cylinder's curved side, circular lids excluded.
concepts.key_idea: Unroll it: the border of the round sheet times the height.

concepts.title: Total Surface Area of a Cylinder
concepts.definition: Everything a closed cylinder shows: the rolled sheet plus both round lids.
concepts.key_idea: Rolled sheet plus two lids: 2 x pi x r x (r + h).
question_patterns: find the total surface area of a cylinder

solution_steps.explain: Add the radius of the circular base to the height of the cylinder.
Multiply the sum of radius and height by 2, pi, and the radius to get the total surface area.

concepts.title: Volume of a Cuboid
concepts.definition: The amount of three-dimensional space enclosed by a cuboid, calculated as the product of its length, width, and height.
question_patterns: find the volume of a cuboid

solution_steps.explain: The volume of a cuboid is the product of its length, width, and height.

concepts.title: Volume of a Cylinder
concepts.definition: A cylinder's capacity: the round base's coverage stacked up through its height.
concepts.key_idea: Base disc area times height: pi x r^2 x h.
question_patterns: find the volume of a cylinder

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the radius of the cylinder by itself.
Multiply the squared radius by pi and the height of the cylinder to find the volume.
